Who is Anuj Agnihotri UPSC Topper AIR 1 2025?

Anuj Agnihotri is a medical doctor who completed his MBBS from All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur in 2023. He belongs to Rahata village in Jodhpur, Rajasthan. Before securing AIR 1 in the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2025, he was serving in Delhi, Andaman and Nicobar Islands Civil Service , a Group B gazetted administrative service.

The Union Public Service Commission declared the UPSC CSE 2025 final result on March 6, 2026, where Anuj Agnihotri secured the top rank. Appearing under the General category (Roll Number 1131589), he successfully cleared all three stages of the exam—Prelims, Mains, and the Personality Test.
Anuj Agnihotri UPSC Topper: Number of Attempts

Anuj Agnihotri cleared the UPSC Civil Services Examination in his third attempt. As per media reports, his father mentioned that Anuj prepared without joining any coaching institute and relied on his own discipline and dedication.
He reportedly studied around 13 hours daily, showcasing exceptional commitment and perseverance throughout his preparation journey.

UPSC AIR 1 Anuj Agnihotri Marksheet

The marksheet of Anuj Agnihotri reflects his strong preparation and academic depth. The UPSC Mains Examination consists of nine papers, out of which seven papers are counted for the final merit list.
